mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BLACK_LIST_DETAIL ( detail_idx,homepage_id, black_idx, member_id, member_name, black_type, add_date, add_id, modify_date, modify_id,teach_code, group_idx, category_idx ) VALUES ( BLACK_LIST_DETAIL_SEQ.NEXTVAL,#{homepage_id}, #{black_idx}, #{member_id}, #{member_name}, #{black_type}, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, SYSDATE, #{modify_id}, #{teach_code}, #{group_idx}, #{category_idx} )
mapper.select:
WITH base AS ( SELECT * FROM BLACK_LIST_DETAIL WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND BLACK_IDX = #{black_idx} ) SELECT -- teach_code 모두 포함 (group_idx=0, category_idx=0) (SELECT LISTAGG(teach_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY detail_idx) FROM base WHERE category_idx = 0 AND group_idx = 0 ) AS teach_codes,
(SELECT LISTAGG(teach_code || '_' || group_idx, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY detail_idx) FROM base WHERE group_idx != 0 AND category_idx = 0 ) AS group_ids, (SELECT LISTAGG(teach_code || '_' || group_idx || '_' || category_idx, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY detail_idx) FROM base WHERE category_idx != 0 ) AS category_ids FROM dual
